No payment is taken until you approve the plan. Common questions

Participants document, clean and rehouse objects from a museum collection under the supervision of conservators and documentation specialists, with daily laboratory sessions, lectures and visits to nearby sites. It is suited to students of conservation, museology, archaeology and related subjects.

Dates, location and syllabus are agreed with your institution. A day-by-day plan and a quotation are shared before you commit.

What it covers

  • Documenting objects from a museum collection
  • Cleaning and rehousing them under supervision
  • Daily laboratory sessions and lectures
  • Visits to nearby sites

Day by day

  1. Day 1: Arrival and induction

    The host museum, its collection and the rules for handling objects safely.

  2. Days 2 to 5: Supervised work on the collection

    Documenting, cleaning and rehousing objects with conservators and documentation specialists, with a laboratory session and a lecture each day.

  3. Day 6: Nearby sites

    Visits to sites connected with the collection.

  4. Day 7: Reporting and departure

    Each participant presents the records they made, and the work is handed over to the museum.

Days can be added, removed or reordered. The final itinerary comes with your quotation.
